visualReview.notes: Inspected all seven current portable views against the individual local south-front, tower, concrete-block and north-core photographs. Stepped core, tower fins, recessed open veranda, low Gold/Grand wings, octagonal Aztec Room and open entrance canopy are represented. Review corrected inward roof faces, hidden lower-wing glazing and an over-height slot on the smaller risalit.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all seven current shared-material views and full rear view. Concrete, painted metal, copper and membrane use metric bindings; glass is local. Final review confirmed visible hipped roof surfaces and outward-facing courtyard windows. North-up overlay follows the clipped main-block envelope. Flat shared ground is a material fixture; independent sloped terrain is in the portable scene.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all nineteen final lighting, quality and forced-detail views. Distant levels retain the tower, veranda, Aztec roof, low wings and open canopy; closer levels add windows, roof seams, geometric block relief and balcony screens. Synthetic neighbors are style fixtures. No physical-device frame-rate measurement is claimed.

geographicReview.notes: Main-block envelope is clipped from the connected resort outline at the west conference center and northeast named wings using the official 2024 resort map. Anchor [-112.0229,33.5234], heading -0.2984988781512775; +X east-southeast and +Z south-southwest. Independent Terrarium heights remain unchanged, with datum 379.5739 m at south entrance [-19.5,60]. Foundation extends to -1 m; the model includes terrain rising roughly 2.7 m across its scope. Footprint suppression remains off; other host DEMs can differ.

fidelityReview.scope: Restored historic main hotel block, tower, veranda, Aztec/Gold/Grand rooms and immediate covered approaches; later named lodging wings, separate conference halls, cottages, villas and grounds excluded.
fidelityReview.notes: Original exterior uses individually inspected local Qualla photos, architect-published 1929 floor plans and construction description, and official current resort map. The published 18 by 13.5 inch concrete block module informs a simplified original relief motif. Heights, upper setbacks, rear roofs and exact window spacing are photographic approximations; no precise survey, exact mold reproduction, readable signage or interior fidelity is claimed. No photo pixels are embedded.

runtimeLodReview.notes: All four current levels were visually inspected and pass budgets: 928 skyline, 3152 district, 12974 street and 60176 closeup triangles. Major roof and massing distinctions survive at distance; glazing, block relief and veranda detail return progressively. Error values are authoring budgets, not measured mesh deviations.

geometryValidation.notes: Exact source regeneration, ordinary import verification, four current LOD checks and strict medium-fi audit passed. Source bundle, scene and terrain schemas pass; terrain PNG round-trip error is recorded above. No independent Khronos-validator run is claimed.

limitations: Original medium-fi main-block exterior from individually inspected Qualla photos, architect-published 1929 plans and official 2024 resort map. Not a survey or photogrammetric reconstruction.

Current restored main building only. Later East/Garden/Paradise/Valley/Ocatilla wings, separate conference halls, cottages, villas, pools and broader grounds are excluded. Connected boundary clipping is an explicit scope decision.
Upper-room setbacks, heights, service-side roofs and exact window positions are photo-derived approximations. Original plans guide massing but do not claim that every 1929 interior survives.

Geometric textile-block relief uses the published 18 by 13.5 inch module with a simplified original stepped-leaf motif, not a replica of the exact mold. No photographic pixels, readable signage or interiors are embedded.
Independent terrain rises across the footprint and is not flattened; the foundation extends below the south approach datum. Another host DEM can change exact ground contact.
